newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,193 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,193 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 2,193 contracts compared with 1,756 overnight Wednesday.
There were 234 wheat, 1,021 corn, 823 soybean, 47 soymeal, 12 soyoil, three wheat calls, 10 corn calls, eight corn puts, four soybean calls and 31 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/2 to 2-1/4 cents lower, corn was 1-1/2 to 2-1/2 cents lower and soybeans were 2-1/4 to 5-1/2 cents lower.
